newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-WINGER SMALL RECALLED BY SOUTH AFRICA.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WINGER SMALL RECALLED BY SOUTH AFRICA.

text.p: Winger James Small, who missed the final two tests against the British Lions because of injury, was named on Saturday in South Africa's squad for next weekend's Tri-Nations match against New Zealand.
Small was one of 10 backline players named by Springbok coach Carel du Plessis in a provisional 21-man squad to prepare for the match against the All Blacks at Ellis Park next Saturday.

Small suffered a groin strain in the first test against the Lions in Cape Town and has only recently recovered from the injury. He celebrated his return to match fitness with two tries in Western Province's 43-24 win over Northern Free State in the Currie Cup on Saturday.
Du Plessis said five more names would be added to his squad on Sunday night after he had watched the Currie Cup match between the Gauteng Lions and Mpumalanga.
Centre Japie Mulder (shoulder) and full-back Andre Joubert (groin) are still struggling with injury and are doubtful starters for the match against the All Blacks.
But lock Mark Andrew and flanker Ruben Kruger are expected to be among the five names announced on Sunday evening while the recall of World Cup centre Hennie le Roux has also been widely predicted.
Backs: Russell Bennett, Jannie de Beer, Henry Honiball, Percy Montgomery, Pieter Rossouw, Andre Snyman, James Small, Werner Swanepoel, Joost van der Westhuizen, Danie van Schalkwyk.
Forwards: James Dalton, Naka Drotske, Os du Randt, Johan Erasmus, Adrian Garvey, Krynauw Otto, Hannes Strydom, Gary Teichmann (captain), Dawie Theron, Fritz van Heerden, Andre Venter.
